original_review.scope: Parent authored then read every Russian manual UI value against named UI roles, existing locale contract, English root description, actual installed VitePress NotFound and search defaults, and copy/navigation behavior. Includes complete search/modal/key names, navigation/headings/date label, fallback/Codex review wording, copy failure/no-JS guidance, permalink, brand alt and404. Refined quote for consistent second-person grammar, preserving source meaning. Enter/Escape are deliberate key labels. This is separate from workflow units; no native/human certification. Actual rendered UI and no-fallback journey remain required.
